summary: Discover the path to success with our Certified Executive Personal Assistant Training. Equip yourself with the skills needed for top-tier executive assistance.
lede: Executive personal assistant training helps executive assistants, secretaries and office managers support senior leaders in complex organizational settings. It develops practical skills in prioritizing work, communicating with internal customers and selecting problem-solving techniques, alongside an understanding of business strategy and leadership styles. Participants also explore confidentiality and how to represent a manager professionally.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals seeking to advance their role in executive support and management.
modules: Part 1 Principles of Modern Organization Behavior
Part 2 Developing a Relationship of Trust with & Representing Your Manager
Effective Communication, Internal Customer Service & Conflict Management
Part 4 Problem Solving, Multitasking & Dealing with Complexity
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites are required, though familiarity with executive support roles is beneficial.
